faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (adswizz vergibt je Abruf eine listeningSessionID, AIS leitet ueber hash_redirect um, Last-Modified liegt nur 0 s vor dem Abruf, Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst simplecastaudio.com) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Why we rely on indirect speech and euphemisms in everyday life.
kurzfassung: While people often claim to value total honesty, everyday life relies heavily on indirect speech, euphemisms, and social tact. Psychologist Steven Pinker explains that these communication strategies help protect social relationships, prevent awkwardness, and maintain mutual respect. However, as tragic examples show, complete indirectness can sometimes have dangerous consequences.
stichpunkte: Indirect language helps navigate sensitive situations like dating and fundraising without awkward transactions.
Communication serves a dual purpose: exchanging information and establishing social relationships.
Southern pleasantries like bless your heart function as diplomatic tools during verbal conflicts.
Diplomacy and international relations rely heavily on symbolic acts and polite fictions.
Humble bragging allows individuals to signal high status while avoiding direct boasting.
Innuendos provide plausible deniability in high-stakes scenarios like extortion or bribery.
Radical honesty often destroys the tacit assumptions that make friendships and cooperation possible.
A failed bribery attempt at a restaurant illustrates the practical limits of applying social theories.

clips.hook: Asking directly for millions ruins the mood
clips.text: Stating financial demands explicitly at the start of a meeting creates an uncomfortable atmosphere.

clips.hook: Southern politeness as a subtle weapon
clips.text: Polite regional expressions often serve as clever alternatives to direct insults during power struggles.

clips.hook: Insulting your own field to show brilliance
clips.text: An evolutionary biologist dismisses his own academic discipline while simultaneously signaling his superior intellect.
An experiment involving restaurant staff reveals that premium seating can reliably be secured through financial incentives.

clips.hook: A world without filters is a nightmare
clips.text: Complete transparency among individuals creates an environment devoid of warmth and friendship.

beschreibung:
From childhood, we're taught that honesty is the best policy. Yet in everyday life, we hedge, soften our words, and leave things unsaid. This week, we talk with psychologist Steven Pinker about why indirect speech is such a fundamental part of human relationships.

How long can you stay focused on a task before your attention is drawn elsewhere? In our latest YouTube video, we explore what the science says about our shrinking attention spans, and how you can begin to reclaim your focus.
